name: clock-spring-forward
description: Six hours on a 0.85 U/hr profile across a DST change forward that the phone made on its own: the pump's clock starts an hour behind the phone's (with no record: it was set before the window) and the user sets it an hour ahead on its screen 180 minutes ago (a TimeChanged record, and a DateChange too when the change crosses midnight), so it ends on the phone's time. Before it, a 2.0 U pump bolus 240 minutes ago and a 150% temp rate from 200 minutes ago that runs across it (its start is stamped on the old clock, its end on the new); after it, a 1.0 U pump bolus 90 minutes ago. The change is in the log, so every record can be dated to the instant it was written.
